processes.title: Distributed Systems & Storage
processes.summary: Designing gRPC-based multi-node communication for Commvault’s S3 Vault to enable horizontal scaling. Implementing request routing, inter-node messaging, and caching mechanisms to reduce redundant calls and distribute load for GET requests and multipart uploads.
processes.impact: Enabling horizontal scaling for S3-compatible storage, improving throughput and resilience while reducing load on critical backup pipelines.

processes.title: Build Systems & Observability
processes.summary: Owning maintenance and feature development for Bindep, an internal C++ dependency analysis tool. Building health-check endpoints for observability, integrating AI-based log analysis and crash detection, and shipping frontend improvements across a 400K-line React codebase.
processes.impact: Improving reliability of a critical build tool with AI-driven crash analytics, reducing manual log inspection and accelerating issue resolution.

processes.title: Cipher Algorithm Detection
processes.summary: Designed an end-to-end cipher detection pipeline with NIST-inspired feature engineering on raw ciphertext. Ran 40+ experiments across XGBoost, LightGBM, CNNs, Transformers, and BERT-style models. Productionized via a C++ feature extractor with ONNX inference achieving ~270ms per file.
processes.impact: Delivered a production ML system for cipher detection meeting strict latency constraints. The technology is being patented by Commvault, with credit as a named patent holder.

processes.title: LLM-Guided Linux Kernel Policy Optimization
processes.summary: Researching LLM-assisted generation and optimization of Linux kernel-space policies targeting Page Cache behavior. Using eBPF for fine-grained runtime signals and the OpenEvolve framework for controlled policy execution. Benchmarking across YCSB, DuckDB, and Twitter production traces.
processes.impact: Demonstrating that LLM-generated kernel policies can match or outperform existing techniques like ScaleCache under specific workloads, without compromising stability.

processes.title: Operating Systems Peer Mentor
processes.summary: Resolved 550+ student help tickets debugging C codebases across kernel and user space. Supported xv6 kernel projects (copy-on-write, virtual memory, concurrency) and systems assignments (distributed processing, RAID, Unix shells). Authored a GDB debugging guide adopted by TAs.
processes.impact: Handled peak queues of 15–20 students and ~120 tickets/day. Created lasting instructional assets reused across semesters.

processes.title: Full-Stack Fantasy App
processes.summary: Built core Express.js backend services from scratch for a real-time baseball fantasy app. Implemented caching and memoized APIs, translated Figma designs into responsive React interfaces, and improved Git workflows and codebase maintainability.
processes.impact: Reduced API calls per page from 400+ to ~30, significantly improving performance and scalability in a fast-paced startup environment.

processes.title: SmartMigrate — LLM-Powered Asylum Form Filling Agent
processes.summary: Co-founded an LLM-powered legal-tech agent to guide asylum seekers through Form I-589 with context-aware questioning, input validation, and structured output. Built a Next.js frontend and Django backend for LLM orchestration and form data management.
processes.impact: Showed potential to save 50+ attorney hours per case. Won Best Prototype award and successfully pitched to investors.

processes.title: Office Hours Queue — LLM-Powered TA & Student Support
processes.summary: Led a team of five to build a full-stack queue platform replacing a fragile Google Sheets workflow. Integrated LLMs via Microsoft AI Foundry for AI-assisted Q&A, code diffing, and debugging hints. Used Flask + React (Vite) with Redis caching and Server-Sent Events for real-time updates.
processes.impact: Reduced TA debugging time with LLM-generated diffs and summaries. Replaced a manual process with a scalable system, cutting queue backlogs.
